summary: Registration + Payment flow web app (VibeCX). Registration page calculates total amount and passes it to Payment page via localStorage. Payment page displays the stored amount in QR section without recalculation.
architectural_notes: Amount is passed from Registration to Payment page via localStorage key 'vibecxAmount'; Payment page must NOT recalculate.
QR payment section reads amount from localStorage on page load and displays it via #qrAmount span and #paymentAmountInput hidden input.

existing_features.title: On the Register page, when the user clicks the 'Proceed to Payment' button, save the displayed total amount (numeric value, stripped of the ₹ symbol) to localStorage under the key 'vibecxAmount', then navigate to the Payment page. Use the existing totalAmount display element as the source value.

On the Payment page, on load, read the 'vibecxAmount' value from localStorage and display it as '₹<amount>' in the QR amount display element. Also populate a hidden input field with the raw numeric amount. No fee recalculation must occur on the Payment page — only the stored value must be used.

new_feature_requests.summary: Total amount auto-sync from Registration page to Payment page QR section via localStorage (no recalculation on payment page)
